title: passiflora lanceolata
intro: Passiflora lanceolata, commonly known as the wild yellow granadilla, is a species of flowering plant in the family Passifloraceae. This plant is known for its edible fruit and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Passiflora lanceolata include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that have been shown to interact with the nervous system and exhibit antioxidant activity.
